_comment: Refusal bodies for the routes this change touches. Body convention: Platform ErrorResponse { error } read by the Web's conversationRefusals map (src/core/api/conversation-refusals.ts, ADR-0013: mapped by status + machine code, never server prose). POST /conversations/{id}/transfer REUSES its existing codes unchanged and adds ONE: transfer-note-too-long (400). The two existing prose 400/409 bodies (missing target, switchboard FailureReason) stay as they are: changing them is not this change. The picker routes refuse with the group gate's bare 403 (no body) or, for a tenant that is not operational, with the 409 TenantTypeMismatchProblem of RequireOperationalTenant (TenantTypeGateExtensions.cs:51-61, Platform/ADR-0027; transferTargets.operationalTenant below), and clamp paging instead of refusing it. GET /channels/available has no refusal body of its own: 401 unauthenticated, or that same 409 (availableChannels._rule). Every child change's delta spec must cite these codes VERBATIM (verbatim-fixture-citation rule, /xr:propagate).

transfer.precedence: missing-target (400 prose) -> conversation 404 -> not-owner (403) -> transfer-note-too-long (400) -> target-queue-not-found | target-agent-not-found (400) -> switchboard refusal (409 prose)

transferNoteTooLong._note: trimmed note longer than 1000 characters; decided before any move, so nothing is written

targetAgentNotFound._handle: ConversationActor.TargetAgentNotFound (ConversationActor.cs:34), also for an agent whose user is not Active; Web key errors.conversation.target_agent_not_found

notOwner._handle: ConversationActor.NotOwner (ConversationActor.cs:28): the caller neither owns the conversation nor satisfies SupervisorPlus

body.error: Either targetQueueId or targetAgentId must be specified

missingTarget._note: existing prose body, unchanged by this change

switchboardRefused._note: ConversationActor.Conflict(result.FailureReason) as today; a note is NOT written on this path

forbidden._note: group RequireAuthorization("Permission:contacts:conversation:transfer"); a caller without the permission gets the policy's bare 403 before the handler. An impersonation token passes only on a minted permission.

body.title: Operational endpoint not available on this tenant type
body.detail: <prose naming the caller's tenant type and the impersonation route>

operationalTenant._note: group RequireOperationalTenant() (TenantTypeGateExtensions.cs:51-61, Platform/ADR-0027): the caller's tenant is not a Customer tenant. Same body as every operational group, /conversations and /channels included. The console never meets it (an Agent lives in a Customer tenant) and would map it by status, never by the prose.

paging._rule: no 400: page < 1 reads as 1; pageSize < 1 reads as 1; pageSize > 200 reads as 200

availableChannels._rule: no refusal body of its own; 401 unauthenticated, 409 TenantTypeMismatchProblem from RequireOperationalTenant when the tenant is not operational. An empty tenant answers 200 with []
